messages:
Anya: Postmortem follow-up: three action buckets from last nightmissing spans, aggregation skew in hourly metrics, and recurring ETL lag. Need owners and short mitigations.

Rafi: I'll take ETL lag. Quick find: node autoscaler failing to drain old pods -> temporary backlog. Short mitigation: increase max nodes and add a drain-safe-hook. ETA: mitigation today, root-cause plan in two weeks.

Noel: I'll own the aggregation skew. Hypothesis: race in window close when downstream ACK is delayed causing duplicate merges. Short fix: add idempotency token at merge key and a dedupe step. ETA: PR in 5 days.

Tess: I'll take missing spans. Repro shows headers dropped by the gzip middleware when content-length missing. Short mitigation: preserve trace headers in gzip filter and enable 100% sampling in canary. ETA: 48h.

Anya: Proposed cadence: daily async status in this thread for 1 week, then weekly until closed. If any item >2w escalate. Also I'll own the checklist doc.

InfraBot: [alert] autoscaler failed to scale up in cluster-prod-eu 02:12 UTC. See: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/9001

Rafi: Mitigation done: bumped nodepool max from 10->15 and added drain-safe-hook. Watching etl.consumer.lag and nodepool.drain_fail_count.

Noel: PR created: https://git.redwood/internal/agg/dedupe/pull/9. Adding unit + integration tests for out-of-order events.

Tess: Pushed gzip header preservation: https://git.redwood/internal/frontend/middleware/pull/210. Starting 24h canary now.

Anya: Action summary and owners:
- Rafi: ETL autoscaler mitigation + runbook, monitor for 48h (owner: Rafi)
- Noel: Aggregation dedupe patch + tests, PR by 5 days (owner: Noel)
- Tess: Tracing header preserve + staging canary, 48h canary (owner: Tess)
- Anya: checklist + daily thread updates (owner: Anya)

Rafi: Added runbook snippet and alarm thresholds to checklist.

Tess: Canary shows 0 missing spans in first 8h. Continuing.

Anya: Thanks team, keep updates here. I'll attach the checklist to the postmortem doc and schedule a 20m sync if any blocker pops up.
